## Never-block contract (review focus 1)
Traced every `resolve_base` path: non-`origin/` base → verbatim return, zero git calls (case 34 proves via raising monkeypatch). Fetch: `CalledProcessError` / `TimeoutExpired` / `OSError` all caught → NOTE → degrade (case 35 pins `timeout == FETCH_TIMEOUT_S`). On POSIX, `subprocess.run`'s post-timeout path is `kill()` + `wait()` on the direct child — no grandchild-pipe re-communicate (that hang class is Windows-only), so the 120 s bound holds on this platform. Probe: `OSError` caught → fallback; a `returncode != 0` (no-remote, non-git tree, vanished dir) → loud local-`main` fallback (case 33). Missing git binary → OSError on both → fallback. No raising or blocking path found.
